say: In training, Claude fires the rays of its own logo.
Fling jabs a single ray forward, and the ray grows back.
Combobulating punches out a line of three dots, then a square of four.
It punches, and kicks low while crouching.
It parries a block from the side, and the whip from above.
Holding the parry button keeps the shield up, and the blocks bounce off.
Dashing with the shield up knocks Stack Overflow flying.
Crouching, it can still walk, slowly.
